description: This configuration describe the configuration for an auto generated API.

enabled.description: Use this to enable or disable this feature

host.description: The host the HTTP server should listen on.

port.description: The port the TCP server should listen on.

openApiFilePath.description: The location the OpenApi Generated should be stored.

startupDelay.description: The startup delay imposed on the http server in milliseconds. Cause the http server to delay its startup.

reloadFrequency.description: Controls how often the server should check for new db schema changes, in milliseconds.

allowFiltering.description: Cassandra only. Allows queries that filter on columns the primary key cannot satisfy, which requires a cluster-wide scan. Defaults to false, so such queries are rejected with a 400.

hosts.description: The database endpoints in host:port form. Each entry may instead be the name of an ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE, which may itself hold a comma separated list. Takes precedence over 'host' and 'port'.

host.description: Single host of the database. Superseded by 'hosts'. This can be the host in plain text or the name of an ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE.

port.description: The port the database is listening for connections on. Used together with 'host'.

password.description: The password of the database user. The password can be put in plain text or as ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE that can be picked up at runtime.

databaseName.description: The name of the database. For Cassandra this is the keyspace.

localDatacenter.description: Cassandra only, and required there: the local datacenter the driver routes to. Startup fails without it.

jdbcUrl.description: Postgres and Cockroach only. Used verbatim when set, bypassing 'hosts', 'host' and 'port'.

targetServerType.description: Postgres and Cockroach only. Appended to the generated JDBC url.

sslEnabled.description: Set to true to establish an SSL connection

sslCertPath.description: The path of the ssl certificate to use for ssl connections. Required when 'sslEnabled' is set to true
